+"""Read an account number back to its sequence."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+
+_NUMBER = re.compile(r"YMS-(\d{4})-(\d{4})")
+
+
+def parse_account_number(text: str) -> int:
+    """Return the sequence of ``YMS-0000-0001``-style numbers. Raise ``ValueError`` otherwise."""
+    match = _NUMBER.fullmatch(text)
+    if match is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"not an account number: {text!r}")
+    return int(match.group(1)) * 10_000 + int(match.group(2))

+import pytest
+
+from bank import ledger
+from bank.account_numbers import parse_account_number
+
+
+def test_parse_gives_the_sequence():
+    assert parse_account_number("YMS-0001-2345") == 12345
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("sequence", [1, 9999, 10000, 99999999])
+def test_parse_round_trips_with_account_number(sequence):
+    assert parse_account_number(ledger.account_number(sequence)) == sequence
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("text", ["YMS-CLR-EUR", "YMS-1-2", ""])
+def test_parse_refuses_text_that_is_not_an_account_number(text):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        parse_account_number(text)
